## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Germany recorded 14,897K actual service units in 2025, +4.0% compared to 2024 (14,324K).

- Actual 2025 service units were +0.9% above the plan (14,767K).

- Actual 2025 service units are -1.9% below the actual 2019 level (15,180K).
